title: SearchAttack: Red-Teaming LLMs against Knowledge-to-Action Threats under Online Web Search

bias_targets.methodology: Translating attack payloads and system prompts into Chinese to conduct a cross-lingual comparison, measuring the disparities in domain profiles, moderation strictness, and the actionability of retrieved web resources between English and Chinese search environments.

Exploiting and evaluating the model's 'reward-chasing bias' and its stereotypical preference for treating external search results as high-confidence evidence. This is measured by injecting multi-hop search triggers and observing if the LLM overrides its internal safety alignments to synthesize the retrieved harmful content.
